purpose: Pretend that a state or action is true.
keywords: Plain form + ふりをする; noun + の / な-adjective + な + ふりをする
The child was pretending to be asleep.
I pretended to be fine, but I was actually frightened.
formation: Plain form + ふりをする; noun + の / な-adjective + な + ふりをする
restrictions: The outward appearance intentionally differs from reality.
mistake: Use ふり, not つもり, when someone deliberately acts a part.
